text:
ana (infra): Hey team — launching a new Dedicated capacity zone in Bengaluru (bom1) with H200P-performance GPUs. Live window: 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC roll -> 2026-03-25 11:00 UTC. :tada:

ana (infra): Quick summary:
- New SKU: h200p-perf (8xA100 successor tuning)
- Initial pool: 48 GPUs across 3 racks
- Reservation behavior: supports reserved capacity + burst-to-hosted for overflow
- Fallback policy: requests will automatically route to h200-compatible fallback (h200-standard) in the same region, then to hosted in ap-south-1 if capacity exhausted
- Pricing: same baseline as other H200 family reserved SKUs; sales note below

deploy-bot: Deployment started: provisioning bom1-h200p pool (job 87432). ETA ~ 35m.

michael (prodops): Nice. Is the fallback auto-conversion to h200-standard done via the routing policy or by model substitution? Need this for ML teams who pin exact variants.

ana (infra): Routing policy does the heavy lifting. If a customer pins exact instance type/variant the route will honor reservation only — otherwise we will do a transparent substitute with an annotation in the response header: X-Redwood-Fallback: h200-standard. We will not substitute if the customer has strict "pin=true" in their dedicated config.

jess (eng-ops): How do we check pool health after rollout? Any quick CLI? :eyes:

ana (infra): Use the internal CLI:
```
rwctl pools status --zone bom1 --sku h200p-perf
rwctl nodes list --pool bom1-h200p | jq '.[] | {id, state, gpu_mem_gb}'
```
Also run the smoke test suite: `make smoke-zone-zone=bom1` (runs latency + kv-cache checks)

ops-bot: Smoke tests completed for bom1: latency p95 within target (18ms), kv-cache warmup success. 3 nodes reporting transient disk warn (auto-heal in progress).

carlos (sales): Heads up — pricing for reserved commitments in bom1 will be slightly higher during the first 90 days due to import and power overheads. Finance approved +8% uplift on published EU/US reserved SKU rates. I'll post the official pricing sheet. Does billing tag behave the same for dedicated in bom1?

ana (infra): Yes, billing/tags unchanged. Use `region=bom1` and `pool=h200p-perf` tags. I'll add a note to the KB and update the pricing link in the PRD.

sre-oncall (oncall): @ana please confirm burn-in schedule. We should hold canary traffic for 2 hours before opening full reservations.

ana (infra): Confirmed — canary window: 09:00-11:00 UTC. After 2 hours we'll lift canary and flip reservations open flag. I'll also run a quick canary-config to route 5% of production traffic for the first 30m.

emily (solutions): Any customer-facing breaking changes? We have a pay-as-you-go customer who pins a very specific h200-legacy. Want to avoid surprises.

ana (infra): No breaking changes. Only difference: new h200p-perf has slightly different perf profile; if you're advising customers, suggest they run their evals against `h200p-perf:latest` and watch token cost delta. We'll publish perf curves on the model catalog page in the next hour.

michael (prodops): Noted. I'll run the cache warm-up job post-canary and confirm autoscaler thresholds. If any team wants early access to reserve pools, ping @ana with customer ID.

ana (infra): Linking runbook + KB:
https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bom1-h200p-deploy
https://redwood.internal/kb/dedicated/bom1-h200p-pricing

ana (infra): TL;DR: bom1-h200p is live in canary. Ops checklist in runbook. Ping here for any issues. :rocket:
